title: Off-grid 1-tonne solar cold store v3
problem_restatement: Provide off-grid solar cold storage for 1 tonne produce holding 5 C at 43 C ambient with night autonomy and safe standing against wind and soft soil.
mechanism_sentence: Sunlight makes electricity that is stored and then runs a fridge that blows cold air over stacked crates to keep 1000 kg of produce near 5 C.
decisive_choices: Grown 3.6 kWp split 2 on roof plus 7 on ground chosen because 2.4 kWp yields only 9.00 kWh per day short of load and 17.6 sqm cannot fit 4.32 sqm roof.
48 V lithium iron phosphate bank chosen because ice-only and eutectic-only output cold not dispatchable electricity to run fans controls and compressor start while thermal stays only as buffer.
DC variable-speed R134a monoblock chosen because only vapour-compression lifts 38 K at 43 C ambient with village service, beating thermal-only and pad-only means.
open_question: Does 250 kg daytime pull-down reach uniform 5 C at 43 C ambient in built hardware with 8 openings?
transfer_line: Energy: split solar array -> battery bank -> monoblock cooler | Measured: temperature probes -> thermostat control

assumed_constraints.constraint: Design for worst-month 5.0 peak sun hours with 0.75 system derate, equator-facing tilt, zero shading 9am-3pm
Staged intake 250 kg per day as 12.5 crates per day with max 8 daytime single-crate openings with strip curtain
Single mixed holding setpoint 5 C at 43 C ambient, 38 K lift, COP 1.40 hot for R134a
Soft soil allowable 150 kPa with screw-anchor hold on separate paths

concept.working_principle: Sunlight to electricity to batteries to vapour-compression cold air over crates near 5 C

parts.name: Insulated chamber with door
parts.material: PIR foam steel facers PVC curtain

connections.label: mounted on gantry and ground frame

constraint_table.constraint: Hold about 1 tonne of fresh produce
constraint_table.how_shown: Calculated 50 crates at 20 kg each for 1000 kg.

constraint_table.design_value: 13.5 kWh per day yield covers 10.4 kWh per day load
constraint_table.how_shown: Yield from 3.60 kWp at 5.00 sun hours set against reconciled electrical load.

constraint_table.constraint: Hold 5 C interior at 43 C ambient over time with staged filling
constraint_table.design_value: 13.5 kWh thermal per day, 203 W conduction, 0.169 kWh per day door
constraint_table.how_shown: Thermal sum with staged 250 kg pull-down converted by COP 1.40 to electrical load.

constraint_table.constraint: Stand on soft soil without overstress
constraint_table.design_value: 23.2 kPa chamber, 28.5 kPa with foundation, below 150 kPa
constraint_table.how_shown: Separated chamber mass on six pads checked against soil capacity.
Wind load on 17.6 sqm split array held by eight screw anchors.

measurement_chain.name: charge controller with disconnect and inverter
attendant with crate log and thermometer

fabrication_steps.description: Set six precast pads with screw anchors and erect roof gantry plus separate ground frame first, because box and array bolt to them on separate load paths.
fabrication_steps.method: Cast and bolted concrete 400 x 400 mm pads, 1.70 kN screw anchors, galvanized tube frame

fabrication_steps.description: Assemble cam-lock PIR box with insulated door plus strip curtain and trapped drain next, because racking cooler and wiring mount inside sealed envelope.
fabrication_steps.method: Bolt-together PIR panels 100 mm walls 120 mm roof, 900 mm door, PVC curtain

fabrication_steps.description: Fit two-row racking with vented crates and mount rear-high monoblock with sealed penetration plus thermostat probes, because airflow loop and control need fixed geometry.
fabrication_steps.method: Slotted-angle steel racking, 600 x 400 mm vented crates, R134a monoblock COP 1.40

fabrication_steps.description: Erect nine 400 W modules split 2 plus 7 and wire MPPT to 48 V battery bank and commission with shed and log, because power must be proven against load before loading produce.
fabrication_steps.method: Fixed-tilt monocrystalline 400 W modules 17.6 sqm, 48 V LiFePO4 10.0 kWh usable, 75 A MPPT

risks.risk: Cloud, extra openings or full-tonne load breaks 3.10 kWh margin and autonomy
risks.mitigation: Enforce staged 250 kg per day, 8 openings, strip curtain, refusal of 51st crate and full warm load.

risks.risk: Hot-ambient derate and non-uniform rear-to-front airflow fails pull-down
risks.mitigation: Use R134a serviceable monoblock with shaded condenser, sealed penetration, trapped drain and 43 C bench test.

risks.risk: Wind uplift 673 kg overcomes anchorage on soft soil
risks.mitigation: Separate chamber and ground-frame footings with eight screw anchors and field pull test.

novelty_claim: Narrower 1-tonne staged 3.60 kWp split-array PIR-box instantiation, not a new principle

figure_spec.system_view: Split array 2 on roof gantry plus 7 on ground frame, PIR box on six pads with 900 mm door, two rack rows with 50 crates and rear-high to low-return airflow

open_questions: Does 250 kg daytime pull-down reach uniform 5 C at 43 C ambient in built hardware with 8 openings?
